[h3]The streak of surprises continues: we’re thrilled to announce that Hotel Tales has surpassed 30,000 wishlists! A huge thanks to all of you for your support and attention to the project![/h3]

We’re already hard at work on the bonus packs and community items unlocked through wishlist milestones. We’ve got plenty of exciting ideas for these rewards, and we’re sure you share our enthusiasm.

This game is a very special project for us. It has gone through many stages: countless mechanics were designed, reworked, and ultimately left behind as we searched for the perfect fit. Guests came and went, checking out with promises to return, while new ones took their place. Now we’re close to release, and the final result is the fruit of tremendous effort put into realizing our vision of Hotel Tales.

We’re more confident than ever and racing toward launch. Very soon we’ll share the exact release date, and believe us — we’re just as eager as you are. So start booking your rooms and clearing your weekends now!

notes.title: Classes postponed!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/6c178a7eeecba9a749f3cbde474fdcbaccce828f.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone! 😔[/p][p]As you can already guess from the title of this post, we have some unpleasant news: we are forced to postpone the release of Femboy Futa House for a while.[/p][h3]What happened?[/h3][p]One of the final steps on the road to releasing a game on Steam is sending the final build for automated review by the store’s moderation. We submitted the build in advance, and that’s where the unexpected happened: Steam’s response “got stuck.” We received a rejection of the build, but the moderators never got back in touch. Even submitting a new request didn’t change anything. Meanwhile, the release date was steadily approaching, and we were helplessly bombarding support with messages.[/p][p]This is far from our first launch on Steam, and we have never before encountered such strange circumstances. It’s quite possible that all of this is just one big misunderstanding, but that doesn’t change the fact that technically we cannot launch Femboy Futa House on the date we had originally set.[/p][h3]What are we doing?[/h3][p]Even if we ourselves are in no way to blame for the delay, we still feel that we have let you, our fans, down. We are determined to make the best possible use of this forced waiting time:[/p][olist][*][p]Go through the entire game thoroughly to find and fix all remaining bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]To compensate, we’ll be adding one new skin for two of the characters. Which ones — that’s still a secret![/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/a0d1f4810e206d7f1d67b14e0655c0d26af93b7c.png"][/img][/p][h3]Once again: we are sorry![/h3][p]According to our estimates, the release will have to be postponed for 2-3 weeks. We’ll keep you updated and do everything we can to make sure your wait is worth it.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience, understanding, and support. Big hugs and kisses to you all ❤️❤️❤️[/p]

Let`s push up to 150,000 and turn this wild life simulator into a full-blown saga — with sequels, new characters, and even crazier adventures. Let’s gooo![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/19cbdbb7792bc1509c86aecd438e826f7341944a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Back to Work[/b][/h3][p]Today’s devlog is all about the mini-games you'll find in between classes, flirting, and… well, everything else that happens afterward. These aren’t just fun little distractions — they’re your way to earn money, unlock bonus content, and even influence the story.[/p][p]Let’s start with something simple and familiar: an autorunner! Jump over obstacles, dodge annoying pigeons, and grab as many coins as you can.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/ea65e3ba95c12b42e7ca75706b3cfa16fbfdf772.png"][/img][/p][p]Not feeling like going outside? Work a shift in the warehouse instead. Just catch their bestsellers with your box — easy, right?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/f027da8f0eeaa74674b11443bbe84a3d430be4f5.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]For Mind and Body[/b][/h3][p]Trips to the restroom are more complicated than they seem — not only do you need to pick the right stall for the right need, but there's always a chance you’ll run into invading spirits. After a fight like that, you might not even need to go anymore.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/c84a64a02db46cfd4feecd7125e29350d0036acb.png"][/img][/p][p]Want more cards for your collection? Try piecing them together before the timer runs out![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/525a0480ab72c44bb35467b353c94294d69d10cf.png"][/img][/p][p]If you played the demo of Femboy Futa House, you might remember how characters mentioned a high score table for mobile games on the protagonist’s phone. By climbing the ranks, you’ll unlock special “text message” scenes. These get added to your collection and reveal even more juicy tidbits about the world.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/0c2ad29519fedfe065de56c28a2d4347b7fec3d9.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Fans only[/b][/h3][p]We decided to take the fanservice idea a step further. Many of our strong and independent characters run their own subscription pages. You might have enough coins to subscribe to everyone… but you’ll be delivering truckloads of pizza to make it happen.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/c50031a527bb0b51d113877b1866f70edc1a69fe.png"][/img][/p][p]And don’t get too comfy playing with toys or browsing pics: you still have to [i]study[/i]! Not just spamming the “cram” button, but actually listening to professors and paying attention to what the other students are saying. At the end of each week, you’ll face exams, and your performance will affect not only your grades, but also the story.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, we want to show you the updated world map screen — one of the most important parts of the game. Compared to the demo, we’ve added a ton of new details, colors, and icons for all the many activities across campus.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/474f96fb9a62f415383ec8390af2351c36d2fa7d.png"][/img][/p][p]As you can see, our life sim has all the real life essentials: wasting time on games and juggling side hustles to make ends meet. What more could you want — a dating sim inside a dating sim?[/p][p]Heh. Keep on dreaming![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE"][/dynamiclink][/p]
